sections.Profile:
The "Classy Bowler" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in July 1956, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game with a bowling theme. Designed by Wayne Neyens and featuring artwork by Roy Parker, the machine includes two flippers, four pop bumpers, two slingshots, five standup targets, and two gobble holes.
